column1: # Lasagna 2 M2.2B canonical anchor manifest v1.2

column2: M1.6 SHALL NOT contribute to M2.3 coverage.
The canonical anchor manifest SHALL be normative.
The verifier SHALL NOT contain an independent canonical phrase list.
stratum(segment) = predictor_type stored by the frozen V1 reference encode
M2.2B-COVERAGE: each of MEAN, LINEAR and RW SHALL contain at least 500 qualifying reference segments.
Candidate selection SHALL use measured comparable encoded rate, not nominal segment-entry size.
M2.2C SHALL be the only phase authorized to materialize the frozen M2.3 corpus.
RULE_ANCHOR = immutable ID and phrase across minor revisions.
A minor revision SHALL be additive-only except for the frozen mutable revision metadata sets, which SHALL NOT expand in a minor revision.
A major revision SHALL be required for any normative semantic change, including any numeric threshold change.
A superseded rule-anchor SHALL remain retained; its replacement SHALL use a distinct anchor ID; SUPERSEDES records SHALL be append-only and immutable.
Superseding a rule-anchor SHALL require a major revision.
A major revision SHALL re-freeze REFERENCE_CORE_SHA256; the value MAY remain identical.
RETENTION_STORE = docs/protocol-history/m2-2b/vX.Y/; each revision SHALL retain rate-distortion-design.md, m2-2b-anchors.tsv and SHA256SUMS and SHALL be Git-tracked.
From protocol revision 1.3 onward, predecessor verification SHALL use direct retained-byte comparison.
RETENTION_BOOTSTRAP = v1.0 reconstructed; v1.1 direct-copy; v1.2 in-flight retained; v1.3+ direct predecessor comparison
Whitespace-policy verification SHALL prove application, not declaration only.
VERIFIER_BUG, HARNESS_ALIAS and VERIFIER_POLICY SHALL NOT by themselves justify changing normative methodology.
